summary: The page is well-structured with dark theme styling, but the multi-thumb range slider displays an improper fill highlight spanning from the track origin rather than isolating the selected range.

issues.title: Incorrect fill segment on range slider
issues.description: The active track fill on the dual-thumb slider renders from the left boundary instead of between the two thumbs.
issues.evidence: The 'Ambient bed ducking window' slider fills solid white from 0% to the upper thumb, covering the inactive area before the lower thumb.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the active highlight track to span only between the lower and upper thumb values.
